notes: AGENTS.md and .claude/ are instructions for coding agents (.claude/ holds CLAUDE.md and links into .agents/skills).
.agents/ stays: src/server/features/sam/samSkills.ts bundles every .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md into the Worker.
The build writes 2 Workers: dist/server, the main Worker that the score measures, and dist/open_seo_audit.

pnpm-lock.yaml: Vite 8.3.5, Rolldown 1.2.16 with its bindings, and @oxc-project/types 0.156.0, made with pnpm 10.30.1 --lockfile-only. rolldown 1.0.1, which only the deploy tools use, now shares @rolldown/pluginutils 1.0.1. No other package changed.

bun.lock is new: bun install migrated pnpm-lock.yaml. bun also moved the pnpm settings into package.json: the overrides of pnpm.overrides and of pnpm-workspace.yaml became the top-level overrides, and patchedDependencies moved from pnpm-workspace.yaml. pnpm-workspace.yaml is unchanged.
